metadata.settling_criterion: Compare complete-cycle mean, amplitude and phase; select settled cycles from measured noise and repeatability.
metadata.settings_status: Planning parameters; keep the existing TEC 10–45 C limit and T1/physical cutoff. No hardware action performed.
metadata.drive_equation: u = Ua_pwm + Ub_pwm*sin(phase_rad); no feedback, lookup or cooling multiplier
metadata.duration_note: Duration is a planning budget, not proof of settling. Keep the full raw record.
metadata.positive_only_note: Ua=32, Ub=5 is a measured-static-curve starting estimate near 40 C, not a guaranteed temperature.
metadata.start_note: Begin zero-centered diagnostics near measured room temperature. Record room temperature independently.
metadata.amplitude_departure: Positive-only Ub=5 is reduced from zero-centered Ub=50 for temperature headroom. Document and account for this change; waveform differences are not attributable to polarity alone.
metadata.starting_offset_note: Ua=32 PWM is a historical static-curve starting estimate near 40 C; verify actual mean and peak with rod attached and measured ambient.

sensor_map_snapshot.diameter_source: User-reported caliper measurement on 2026-11-04; instrument precision 0.01 mm, not a complete uncertainty budget.
sensor_map_snapshot.note: Inherited coordinates are reference only. Module 8 starts with T1 at the first hole and downstream probes approximately one inch apart; remeasure all positions and L before production. No acquisition/analysis script treats this pending map as measured Module 8 geometry.
